strings.Interface translations are JSON files in: Interface translations are JSON files in the locales folder next to the executable. Drop a file there to add a language.
strings.Model and runtime switching is locked wh: Model and runtime switching is locked while recording or transcribing.
strings.The selected model is not downloaded yet: The selected model is not downloaded yet — the selection applies once it is ready.
strings.Preview the start cue at the volume abov: Preview the start cue at the volume above.
Preview the end cue at the volume above.
strings.Start silently (no windows when launched: Start silently (no windows when launched at startup)
strings.Using the Windows default device. Virtua: Using the Windows default device. Virtual cables (VB-Audio, streaming devices) record silence — pick your real microphone above if transcriptions are empty.
strings.Used for new recordings. If the Windows: Used for new recordings. If the Windows default is a virtual cable, a real microphone is selected automatically.
strings.Swap left and middle mouse button action: Swap left and middle mouse button actions on the tray icon
strings.Left click records and pastes at the cur: Left click records and pastes at the cursor; middle click records a new message.
strings.Left click records a new message; middle: Left click records a new message; middle click records and pastes at the cursor.
strings.After the text inserted in record-and-pa: After the text inserted in record-and-paste mode (paste hotkey or middle click):
strings.The current model cannot detect the lang: The current model cannot detect the language automatically — pick a language code.
strings.Accepts sound from a page or a script (P: Accepts sound from a page or a script (PCM16, mono) and returns the transcription. The app's own microphone is not used.
strings.This host is reachable from the network:: This host is reachable from the network: anyone who can open the port can start recordings.
strings.GET /api/status — state, live te: GET  /api/status        — state, live text, received audio.
strings.GET /api/models — models this bu: GET  /api/models        — models this build can use.
strings.POST /api/record/stop — finish and tra: POST /api/record/stop   — finish and transcribe the buffer.
strings.GET /api/record/live — live text of t: GET  /api/record/live   — live text of the session.
strings.GET /api/record/text — transcript of: GET  /api/record/text   — transcript of the last session.
strings.The test page is a separate project: api: The test page is a separate project: api-demo/ (run: node api-demo/server.mjs). The API has no authentication — anyone who can reach the port can send audio.
strings.Records a new message; the transcribed t: Records a new message; the transcribed text is copied to the clipboard and saved as a new history entry.
strings.Records a piece and appends it to the la: Records a piece and appends it to the last message; the full merged text is copied to the clipboard afterwards.
strings.Records a new message and pastes it at t: Records a new message and pastes it at the cursor of the window that was active when recording started; the previous clipboard content is restored afterwards.
strings.press Ctrl/Alt/Shift + key (or an F-key): press Ctrl/Alt/Shift + key (or an F-key), Esc cancels
strings.The sound comes from the API client, not: The sound comes from the API client, not from this machine. The text goes back to the caller and is saved in the history; Stop ends the session.
strings.Recording is unavailable until a model i: Recording is unavailable until a model is ready.
strings.Voice Button - left click: record and pa: Voice Button - left click: record and paste, middle click: record
strings.Voice Button - left click: record, middl: Voice Button - left click: record, middle click: record and paste
